Our story
A journey reflecting the evolution of global logistics.
2012
Where SanFreight began
The year 2012 marked the start of SanFreight Logistics — 20 shipments, a small Mulund office, and one belief: cargo deserves greater care.
Led by founder Ankush Salunkhe, the company delivered its first major consignment to Afghanistan that same year — a defining moment that set the tone for the reliability and reach SanFreight is known for today.
2013
Reaching new continents
In 2013, SanFreight handled its first breakbulk cargo from China and began serving the European continent — early proof that a young Mumbai company could take on complex freight across the world’s busiest trade lanes.
2014
Certified and established
In 2014, SanFreight moved into its own office in Vashi and earned ISO 9001 and 14001 certification — turning a fast-growing freight company into a name clients rely on, with systems and standards built to match its ambition.
2019
Coming into our own
By 2019, SanFreight had grown into an established multimodal operator, moving cargo by sea, air, and road for clients across India and beyond.
SanFreight’s mission is to bring the entire freight value chain under one roof — giving clients a single, dependable partner driven by reliability, reach, and real-time visibility.
Our reach now extends across Afghanistan, the CIS states, and East and West Africa.
2020
SanFreight crosses 5,000 shipments, a milestone in scale, trust, and consistency.
Crossing 5,000 shipments marked a turning point for SanFreight — proof that a company built on precision could scale without compromise. Every consignment carried the same discipline that defined the first: careful handling, clear communication, and delivery clients could count on.
Our first Vietnam office
In line with SanFreight’s global strategy, our first international office opened in Vietnam, extending our reach into Southeast Asia’s key trade lanes.
Recognised
The India Best MSME Award marked national recognition of SanFreight’s growth — confirming that a company built on trust had earned its place among the country’s most dependable logistics providers.
2021
SanFreight crosses ₹100 crore in sales, a defining year of growth.
In 2021, SanFreight’s sales crossed ₹100 crore — a milestone that proved a freight company built on trust and precision could scale without losing either. The number reflected years of consistent delivery, deepening client relationships, and a reputation earned one shipment at a time across sea, air, and road.
A dedicated Special Export Unit
To handle rising volumes with sharper focus, SanFreight established a dedicated Special Export Unit — a specialised team built to manage complex export movements end to end, ensuring speed, accuracy, and complete visibility for clients shipping to the world’s most demanding markets.
SanFreight opens its Dubai office
SanFreight opens its Dubai office, anchoring the company in one of the world’s busiest trade hubs.
Breakbulk & project cargo
SanFreight builds dedicated capability for heavy-lift, out-of-gauge, and over-dimensional cargo.
From power generation to construction and OEM equipment, SanFreight took on the shipments others avoid — heavy-lift, breakbulk, and project cargo on a global scale.
Backed by strong carrier relationships worldwide and a dedicated team of experts, every complex movement was assessed, planned, and delivered as a tailored end-to-end solution.
Customs clearance expertise
As a licensed Custom House Agent, SanFreight made clearance fast and hassle-free.
SanFreight’s licensed CHA team delivered efficient, cost-effective customs clearance for every cargo type — representing clients through inspections, assessments, and duty payments. Backed by strong relationships with customs agents worldwide and deep expertise, even critical cargo cleared without delay.
2022
A full-fledged Air Division
In 2023, SanFreight launched a full-fledged Air Division and opened its Singapore office, extending fast, reliable air freight across new lanes.
Opening in Singapore
The same year, SanFreight’s team grew to over 150 people — specialists across ocean, air, customs, and project cargo, each bringing the focus and expertise that complex freight demands.
SanFreight revenue crosses ₹167 crore
2023 was a pivotal year: SanFreight crossed ₹167 crore in revenue — a milestone that reflected the strength of its expertise, the trust of its clients, and the commitment of a growing team.
Top 5 in perishables
SanFreight broke into India’s top five for perishable handling — shipping fresh, frozen, and temperature-sensitive cargo by sea, air, and road. From fruits and flowers to pharmaceuticals, a specialised team ensured every consignment arrived protected from delay, loss, and waste.
Transportation & warehousing
Door-to-door movement and secure storage, right across the country.
SanFreight moved every cargo type — general, temperature-controlled, hazardous, ODC — with timebound doorstep pickup, delivery, and warehousing.
2023
Moving forward
After more than a decade of sustained growth, with offices in four countries and a team of over 150 building tomorrow every day, SanFreight keeps moving forward.
Real-time visibility
SanFreight put technology at the heart of the client experience — real-time tracking and streamlined, paperless documentation that keep customers informed at every stage, from pickup to final delivery. Less friction, fewer delays, and complete visibility across every shipment.
On the national stage
SanFreight at the IICS Exhibition, 2024
SanFreight presented at the IICS Exhibition — showcasing its capabilities to the wider industry and trade community.
India 500 CEO Award
Recognised in 2024
SanFreight’s leadership was honoured with the India 500 CEO Award — recognition of vision, growth, and a decade of trust.
2024
Expanding into oil & liquid tanker handling
SanFreight moved into oil and liquid tanker handling — specialised, high-value cargo few are equipped to manage — extending its expertise into the energy and chemical sectors.
2025
Leading, 2025
Today, SanFreight ranks at the top for perishable handling. But this isn’t a finish line — it’s a running start. The story keeps moving, and so do we.
